nodes.speaker: Archivist
nodes.text: Ah, a visitor. Welcome to the Archives. Every story in the galaxy, catalogued and preserved in proper chronological order.

nodes.speaker: Archivist
text: This is the Holochronicle — a complete record of the Star Wars canon timeline.
Films, series, novels, comics... every piece of the saga, mapped from the dawn of the High Republic to the rise of the First Order.
The holocrons hold the knowledge. The timeline reveals the connections.

nodes.speaker: Archivist
nodes.text: The portal is to my right. Step through and the full timeline awaits — every era, every story, in its proper place. May the Force guide your path.

nodes.speaker: Archivist
nodes.text: Take your time. The Archives are patient. When you're ready, the portal on the right will transport you to the full timeline. The knowledge isn't going anywhere.

nodes.speaker: Archivist
nodes.text: Press ESC to return to the village. The Archives will be here when you need them.
